messages:
Evan G: Heads-up — rehearsal tomorrow 10:30am PT for the webinar. Need sign-off on run-of-show + demo fallback scripts. Can everyone confirm who will own the live demo fallback?

Priya S: I can own the fallback script and the switch to recorded demo if latency spikes. I'll be on mute but monitoring.

Mae R: I'll do presenter cueing and mic checks at 10:15. Also will watch token budget + latency dashboard during the live demo.

Julian H: Can we get a single curl snippet Ops can run to flip to recorded? Put it in the runbook so anyone can execute quickly.

Evan G: yes adding snippet here:
```bash
# switch to recorded demo
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/v1/demo/fallback -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"mode":"recorded","reason":"latency"}'
```

Kait L: Routing for hot leads — if demo triggers >5 signups in 5min, route to #sales-inbox and ping @Priya S @Julian H. That way SDRs can triage immediately. Good?

Priya S: good with me. Also add a Zapier webhook for the form so we get immediate rows in the sheet: https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/12345/abcde

Mae R: Rehearsal checklist updated: mic test, screen-share test, demo VM snapshot, model knob values (batch_size=1, quant=q8). Link: https://docs.redwood/rehearsals/demo-checklist

Julian H: Also: plan for hallucination. If the model produces unsafe/hallucinated output we should hit a "safe-mode" canned response and end the demo. I'll draft 2 canned lines.

Evan G: Good call. Also OpsBot will post health alerts to this thread during rehearsal so presenters can see trending before we go live. OpsBot: please run health check at 10:25am PT.

OpsBot: [automated] health-check scheduled for 2026-04-22T17:25:00Z — initial run queued.

OpsBot: [automated] health-check passed: CPU 68%, GPU 45%, mem 72%, avg latency 180ms

Kait L: One last question — who owns lead routing mapping? @Mae R?

Mae R: I can map leads to the SDR queue and set up the Slack integration tonight. I'll confirm webhook + routing table in the runbook.

Priya S: Awesome. I'll add all of this to the run-of-show doc and tag presenters + ops. :thumbsup:

Evan G: Perfect. Final ask — everyone please hop in #marketing 10:00am PT for a 15-min preflight. Thanks y'all!
